s320_class_prevention_effectiveness.description: S320-class failures are identity failures where remediation targets the wrong variant of an item (e.g., wrong QID within a rotation group). The Gate -1 pipeline prevents this by ensuring every item has a unique, verifiable identity before downstream tools touch it.
s320_class_prevention_effectiveness.s206_prevention_outcome: 0 S320-class failures since v2 activation. Gate -1 catches the 1 structurally unidentifiable item (empty CC) before any downstream tool encounters it. All 2,539 passed items have valid QID + CC, making them operationally targetable.
s320_class_prevention_effectiveness.remaining_risk: Without compound keys (steps 4-5), items within rotation groups that share identical stems but different answer distributions cannot be disambiguated by QID+CC alone. Governance Rules 9-10 (forbidden methodologies: regex-based bulk write, blind clear, multi-pack concurrent write) provide machine-enforced prevention. Full S320-class prevention requires PG-011 steps 4-5 deployment.
s320_class_prevention_effectiveness.governance_layer_protection: Rules 9-10: FM-001 through FM-008 (8 forbidden methodologies) are ACTIVE and enforced by governance-guard.js. These block the script operations that historically caused S320-class failures (e.g., DL-019 concurrent-write overwrite, DL-028 remediation tooling regression).

certified_pool_impact.description: The 1 blocked item (Pack D empty-CC) is NOT Certified — it is not in the learner delivery pool. All 2,221 Certified items pass Gate -1 step 2 (valid CorrectChoice). The 40 regex-gap blocks are format-level, not structural — all 40 P1-E-R* items are Certified and structurally complete.
certified_pool_impact.learner_pool_exposure: NONE at Gate -1 level. All blocked items are either non-Certified (1 item) or false-positive format blocks (39 items). The 1 structurally incomplete item (P1-E-R33, now resolved) is confirmed structurally complete by S207 T0 verification.

gate_neg1_throughput.comparison_v1: v1 had ZERO automated gate execution. Scanning was manual grep-based, taking minutes to hours per defect class. v2 automates in 0.7s what took hours in v1.

pg011_steps_4_5_deployment.description: Deploy TemplateFamily classification and compound key resolution to close the rotation-group identity gap. This completes S320-class failure prevention at the content-semantic level (currently protected at the governance level only).

regex_spec_update.description: Update Pack E regex to include P1-E-R\d{2} format for supplemental items. This clears 39 false-positive identity blocks with zero content risk.

verdict: GATE_NEG1_OPERATIONAL — 99.96% pass rate on production scan. 2,539/2,540 items have valid identity. Zero certified-pool items blocked. Zero S320-class failures since activation. PG-011 steps 4-5 deferred for compound-key identity completion.
